sources.observation: The stepped white facade has a shallow panel grid and a row of circular marine murals. An inset turquoise glass atrium separates the wings.

sources.credit: Kerry Raymond, see linked file for license
sources.observation: Blue sloped glazing and a silver mullion grid meet the entrance landing. Steps, stainless steel handrails and a projecting white canopy frame the entry.

limitations: The builder’s atrium height and the mapped wall line set the main glazing. Marine roundels are drawn as simplified fish and coral forms. Parapet heights, roof equipment and entrance details are photographic estimates.
